# tebib_iam_group (Resource)

An IAM group of users. Policies attached to the group apply to its members. Add members with `tebib_iam_group_membership`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_iam_group" "ops" {
  name        = "ops"
  description = "Operators"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (1-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 +=,.@_-). Changing it replaces the group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID (`o-...`). Default: the provider's `organization`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Group ID (`grp-...`).
- `member_count` (Number) How many users are in the group.
- `trn` (String) TRN, the `principal` of policy attachments.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import tebib_iam_group.ops grp-abc123
```
